requirements.requirement: The system must validate via unit tests that every provider quality measure object includes a non-null provenance metadata object.
The system must validate via unit tests that every clinical trial measure object includes a non-null provenance metadata object.
The system must validate that provenance metadata includes all required fields (source_type, source_name, api_endpoint, dataset_id, retrieval_timestamp, version).
The system must validate that retrieval_timestamp in provenance metadata is a valid ISO 8601 datetime string.
The system must validate that source_name correctly matches the expected external system for each measure (e.g., CMS, ClinicalTrials.gov).
The system must validate via integration tests that provenance metadata is preserved through the evaluate_care_facade and returned in API responses.
The system must validate that no measure is returned by the API without provenance metadata present.
The system must fail tests if any provenance field is null or missing in a returned measure.
The system must validate that provenance metadata remains unchanged between service layer output and API response serialization.
The system must include regression tests that detect removal of provenance fields from any measure schema.
The system must simulate an exception where an external data source does not return source metadata and assert that the measure is either rejected or flagged as invalid.
The system must simulate an exception where retrieval_timestamp is malformed and assert that the test fails validation.
The system must validate that multiple measures in a single response each carry independent and correct provenance metadata.
The system must validate that provenance metadata is attached at the time of data retrieval and not added post hoc in downstream layers.
